title: Japanese Given Names: Data, Analysis, and Interactive Resources
description: This repository provides curated datasets, analysis code, documentation, and visualization tools for the empirical study of contemporary Japanese given names. It includes frequency data harvested from public web sources, cleaned and normalized datasets, diversity and distribution metrics, validation scripts, and code for interactive exploration and visualization. The resource was originally developed in support of the book Gender in Japanese Names Today and is maintained as a citable research platform for computational, quantitative, sociolinguistic, and onomastic research on Japanese given names. Original source materials remain copyright of their respective rights holders; rights and reuse conditions are documented in the accompanying RIGHTS.md file.
notes: This resource has mixed rights. The code, documentation, and derived analysis outputs are released under the MIT licence.
